summary: Yakima County lookout site: 1942 cabin, 1946 L-4 tower, 1960 40-ft tower; removed or toppled 1971-72 (sources differ); footings on site per photos.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Its heading says R.I.P. 1942-1946, but the body describes the 1960 tower and a 1971 loss, so the body text is used.

notes_for_editor: Brief status 'gone' holds. Footings and an emergency cabin appear in Willhite's photo captions, which give no dates, so the story says footings remain rather than nothing. Unresolved: the 1971 date (Register, firelookout.com) against the April 1972 Oregonian toppling, which the story reports side by side; and Wenatchee versus Snoqualmie National Forest in the 1972 quote. No staffing or fire sources found after two searches. Access reading rests on Willhite's route and a Forest Service trail listing; no official closure check was run. No photo URLs captured because fetch_text returns text only.
